title: ⚠️ SAFETY WARNING — RINK HOCKEY MANAGER 🏒
author: FerjorPT
selftext:
The RHM development team hereby informs that, during recent graphics tests in Godot 4:

✅ No crash test dummies were physically harmed.  
✅ All players survived the transition to the new 3D models.  
✅ Tester01 is in stable condition, although he temporarily lost his skeleton during export.  
✅ The incident at the back of the rink, involving 8 stacked players, was the photographer’s fault, not the match engine’s.

⚠️ Several cases were reported of shirts losing their colour, sticks abandoned on the floor, and players with their arms permanently wide open.

📢 The crowd, until yesterday made up of motionless coloured capsules, has been promoted to human beings and now celebrates goals, applauds saves and boos the referee. The Capsules’ Union has yet to respond.

![img](puyd3l7exsxh1 "The safety of our dummies remains a priority.")

~~The safety of our dummies remains a priority.~~

*Rink Hockey Manager — Department of Safety, Testing and Improbable Accidents.*  
**Fernando, Gip, Sol and Son** 😂🏒
